data/aase/function/tick.mcfunction:
# animation driver
scoreboard players add #t aase_t 1
execute if score #t aase_t matches 0 run function aase:frames/frame_0
execute if score #t aase_t matches 2 run function aase:frames/frame_1
execute if score #t aase_t matches 4 run function aase:frames/frame_2
execute if score #t aase_t matches 6 run function aase:frames/frame_3
execute if score #t aase_t matches 8 run function aase:frames/frame_4
execute if score #t aase_t matches 10 run function aase:frames/frame_5
execute if score #t aase_t matches 12.. run scoreboard players set #t aase_t 0
schedule function aase:tick 1t
data/aase/function/load.mcfunction:
scoreboard objectives add aase_t dummy
scoreboard players set #t aase_t 0
# then run:  function aase:summon   and   function aase:tick
